title: Legal & Compliance
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El inglés legal es un idioma en sí mismo. Conocer términos como 'Null and void' o 'Breach of contract' asegura que puedas proteger los intereses de tu empresa en cualquier negociación internacional.

parts.visual:
En el nivel directivo, interactuarás constantemente con contratos y regulaciones. 

1. Binding (Vinculante): 
- Un acuerdo que tiene fuerza legal y debe ser obedecido. 
Ej: This email constitutes a legally BINDING contract. 

2. Null and void (Nulo y sin efecto): 
- Un contrato o cláusula que carece de validez legal, a menudo por un error o fraude. 
Ej: Because it wasn't signed, the agreement is NULL AND VOID. 

3. Breach of contract (Incumplimiento de contrato): 
- Romper las reglas establecidas en un acuerdo legal. 
Ej: Failing to deliver the goods on time is a clear BREACH OF CONTRACT.
parts.audio: Welcome to Legal English and Compliance. At the executive level, you will constantly deal with contracts and regulations. Number 1: Binding. This means an agreement has legal force and must be obeyed. For example: This email constitutes a legally BINDING contract. Number 2: Null and void. This refers to a contract or clause that has no legal force, often due to an error or fraud. For example: Because it wasn't signed, the agreement is NULL AND VOID. Number 3: Breach of contract. This means breaking the rules or failing to perform what was promised in a legal agreement. For example: Failing to deliver the goods on time is a clear BREACH OF CONTRACT.

parts.visual:
4. Loophole (Vacío legal / Escapatoria): 
- Una ambigüedad en la ley o contrato que permite a alguien evitar una obligación. 
Ej: The company used a tax LOOPHOLE to avoid paying millions. 

5. Liability (Responsabilidad legal / Obligación): 
- Ser legalmente responsable de algo, especialmente de pagar por daños. 
Ej: We need insurance to cover our LIABILITY in case of accidents. 

6. Non-disclosure agreement / NDA (Acuerdo de confidencialidad): 
- Contrato para mantener en secreto información compartida. 
Ej: Please sign this NDA before we discuss the software. 

7. Due diligence (Debida diligencia / Auditoría previa): 
- Investigación exhaustiva antes de firmar un contrato o comprar una empresa. 
Ej: We must perform DUE DILIGENCE before acquiring the startup.
parts.audio: Number 4: Loophole. An ambiguity or inadequacy in the law or a set of rules that allows someone to avoid an obligation. For example: The company used a tax LOOPHOLE to avoid paying millions. Number 5: Liability. Being legally responsible for something, especially paying for damages. For example: We need insurance to cover our LIABILITY in case of accidents. Number 6: Non-disclosure agreement, or NDA. A contract to keep shared information a secret. For example: Please sign this NDA before we discuss the software. Number 7: Due diligence. A comprehensive appraisal or investigation of a business undertaken before a merger or acquisition. For example: We must perform DUE DILIGENCE before acquiring the startup.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término legal corporativo correcto.

questions.question: Once both parties sign this document, it becomes a legally ____ agreement. (Vinculante).
Because the contract was signed under pressure, the judge declared it null and ____. (Nulo y sin efecto).
questions.explanation: Null and void = expresión legal para nulo e inválido.

questions.question: The supplier didn't deliver the materials on time, which is a clear ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento).
questions.explanation: Breach of contract = incumplimiento de contrato.

questions.question: The billionaire's lawyers found a tax ____ that allowed him to pay zero taxes legally. (Vacío legal).
questions.explanation: Loophole = vacío legal, ambigüedad que permite evadir la norma.

questions.question: As a company director, you have limited ____ in case the company goes bankrupt. (Responsabilidad financiera/legal).
questions.explanation: Liability = responsabilidad legal, especialmente referida a deudas o daños.

questions.question: Before buying the competitor, our accountants spent three months performing due ____. (Auditoría previa / Investigación profunda).
questions.explanation: Due diligence = debida diligencia (investigación legal y financiera previa a una compra).

questions.question: We can't discuss the secret project until you sign this ____-disclosure agreement (NDA).
A ____ is a lawsuit filed by a large group of people who all suffered from the same issue. (Demanda colectiva).
The fine print in the contract contains several ____ clauses that protect the company. (Cláusulas).
If you use our logo without permission, you are committing copyright ____. (Infracción).
questions.explanation: Copyright infringement = infracción de derechos de autor.

questions.question: The contract includes a ____ agreement, meaning the employee cannot work for a competitor for two years. (No competencia).
questions.explanation: Non-compete clause/agreement = cláusula de no competencia.

questions.question: Both parties agreed to settle the dispute out of ____ to avoid massive legal fees. (Fuera del tribunal).
questions.explanation: Settle out of court = llegar a un acuerdo extrajudicial.

questions.question: The company was found guilty of money ____. (Lavado de dinero).
A person who exposes illegal or unethical activity within a company is called a ____. (Denunciante / Informante).
The HR department ensures ____ with all local labor laws. (Cumplimiento normativo).
In the event of a dispute, this agreement shall be governed by the ____ of the State of New York. (Jurisdicción / Leyes).
questions.explanation: Governed by the laws of = regido por las leyes de (cláusula de jurisdicción).

questions.question: The company filed for Chapter 11 ____ to restructure its massive debts. (Bancarrota).
The contract has a ____ clause, allowing either party to end the agreement with a 30-day notice. (Terminación).
questions.explanation: Termination clause = cláusula de terminación o rescisión.

questions.question: The CEO was accused of ____ trading because he bought shares just before the merger was announced. (Uso de información privilegiada).
questions.explanation: Insider trading = uso ilegal de información privilegiada para operar en bolsa.

questions.question: Force ____ is a clause that frees both parties from liability in case of an extraordinary event, like an earthquake. (Fuerza mayor).
questions.explanation: Force majeure = fuerza mayor (término legal francés usado en inglés).

questions.question: A legally ____ contract. (Vinculante con B)
Null and ____. (Nulo y sin efecto con V)
A ____ of contract. (Incumplimiento con B)
A tax ____. (Vacío legal con L)
Limited ____. (Responsabilidad legal con L)
Due ____. (Auditoría previa con D)
A ____-disclosure agreement. (Confidencialidad con N)
Copyright ____. (Infracción con I)
Settle out of ____. (Tribunal con C)
A corporate ____. (Denunciante interno con W)
